abstract: A radioimmunoassay for placental protein 12 (PP12) is described and the levels in amniotic fluid, cord blood, and serum of nonpregnant individuals, pregnant women, and patients with trophoblastic disease are presented. During pregnancy, the highest PP12 levels were found at 22 to 23 weeks (mean +/- SD, 169 +/- 123 ng/ml), and there was a transient decline at 32 to 33 weeks (63 +/- 23 ng/ml). In amniotic fluid, the levels were 100 to 1,000 times higher than in maternal serum. In cord blood at birth, the values were of the same magnitude as in maternal serum. Also healthy nonpregnant women and men had PP12-like immunoreactivity in serum. Nonpregnant women (9 to 47 ng/ml) had higher levels than men (undetectable to 21 ng/ml). Elevated levels up to 84 ng/ml were occasionally observed in trophoblastic disease, both hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma, but they bore no correlation with the human chorionic gonadotropin levels. On the basis of these results PP12 is not a suitable marker for trophoblastic disease. PP12 values in normal pregnancy provide the basis for the evaluation of PP12 levels in abnormal pregnancy.
abstract_ja: 胎盤蛋白12(PP12)のラジオイムノアッセイを記述し、羊水、臍帯血、非妊娠女性・男性、妊娠女性、および絨毛性疾患患者の血清におけるレベルを提示した。妊娠中のPP12値は妊娠22~23週で最も高く(平均±SD、169±123ng/ml)、32~33週で一過性に低下した(63±23ng/ml)。羊水中のレベルは母体血清の100~1,000倍高かった。出生時の臍帯血の値は母体血清と同程度であった。健康な非妊娠女性(9~47ng/ml)は男性(検出限界以下~21ng/ml)より高いレベルを示した。胞状奇胎および絨毛癌を含む絨毛性疾患では、時に最大84ng/mlの高値が認められたが、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン値とは相関しなかった。これらの結果から、PP12は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の適切なマーカーではないと結論された。正常妊娠におけるPP12値は、異常妊娠におけるPP12値を評価する基準となる。
